prompt_text: Generate a 5-second educational video solving a simple GIS service-location choice using weighted Manhattan distance on a grid map.
expected_concepts: Manhattan distance counts grid blocks horizontally and vertically
Demand weights make some destinations count more heavily
The better candidate site has the lower total weighted distance
expected_visual_elements: Coordinate grid map with three demand points and two candidate sites
Legend showing each demand point weight
Comparison table for total weighted distance at Site X and Site Y
expected_narrative_order: Show the grid map and the two candidate service sites
Compute weighted distance from Site X to all demand points
Compute weighted distance from Site Y to all demand points
Compare the two totals
Choose Site X because its total weighted distance is 16 versus 23
pedagogical_target_audience: Introductory GIS or human geography students learning location-allocation reasoning
discipline_specific_rubric: Uses Manhattan distance rather than straight-line distance
Correctly calculates Site X total as 16 and Site Y total as 23
States the final decision clearly: choose Site X because 16 is lower than 23
